name: Promoter Recognition Benchmark Framework
description: A framework and benchmark for supervised promoter recognition that standardizes datasets, evaluation metrics, and model comparisons for promoter prediction.
reputation: Provides a useful standardized framework that has been adopted by bioinformatics groups seeking consistent promoter-prediction evaluation.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark operating on genomic sequences; subject to class imbalance, species-specific biases, and differences in promoter annotation protocols. Dataset and model comparisons depend strongly on species, windowing, and preprocessing choices.
